neb153fe6e8.headline: Oman: 5 per cent VAT will come into force starting April 16
neb153fe6e8.summary: Oman announced it will introduce a 5 percent value-added tax (VAT) starting April 16, following similar moves by the UAE and Saudi Arabia in 2018.
neb153fe6e8.why: VAT introduction is a major fiscal reform affecting government revenue and consumer prices, impacting business operations and economic activity in Oman.
